  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-005 is a clear and verifiable software requirement specifying that the SFMC software shall control the spacecraft propulsion system to follow the selected route when Autopilot mode is enabled. The requirement is consistent with the SRS context, which defines Autopilot mode as the SFMC controlling the spacecraft toward a pilot-selected destination (SRS §1.3 Operational Modes). The requirement is well-scoped within the software domain, as the SFMC interfaces with the Propulsion System to send commands (SRS §2.3). The requirement aligns with the mission need MN-01 (navigation) and MN-02 (propulsion control). The requirement is stated without ambiguity or undefined terms, and no escape clauses or unverifiable absolutes are present. The SRS provides sufficient context about modes and subsystem interfaces to support this requirement. No NASA Procedural Requirements (NPR) passages directly mandate this specific software function, and no SWE links are justified based on the supplied NPR passages. The requirement writing quality meets NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance for mode requirements (§3.2.1.2) and scope (§3.1.2)."
}
